notes: ὁ κύριος → his lord and τὴν γυναῖκα → his wife align the article to the supplied possessive: αὐτόν is already spent on the object him, so no source word is available to take it (rules 20, 76).
τὰ τέκνα leaves its article unrepresented, the ASV writing no determiner of its own for children (rule 23).
Units v025, v026 and v027 remain underdetermined; every reading is translated alike.
